title: FBI Looks Into Possible Hack of Big Police Database
summary:
The FBI is looking into a possible hack of one of its most important databases. The database is called the National Crime Information Center, or NCIC. Police officers all over the country use it every day. It holds records on people wanted by the police, missing people, criminal histories, and stolen property.

The FBI would not comment on Saturday. The news was first reported by CNN. A person who knows about the case confirmed it to The Associated Press, but asked not to be named. It is not yet clear how big the problem is, and investigators have not said whether anything was taken or changed.

President Donald Trump said in a Fox News interview, 'We just heard about it and I will say that it's not good.' The news came after a run of computer outages. Officials said those outages came from routine work to upgrade computers and fix weak spots, not from a cyberattack. There was no immediate sign that the FBI case was connected to those outages.
why_it_matters: It matters because police use this database to help find missing people and catch criminals, so keeping it safe helps keep everyone safer.

keywords.explanation: The National Crime Information Center is a big police database that holds important records.
